summary.text: A centaur killed by Caeneus at the wedding of Peirithous and Hippodameia.

story.text: Ovid counts Antimachus among the five centaurs Caeneus put to death in the Lapith–centaur war — named beside Styphelus, Bromus, Elymus, and Pyracmos in Nestor's recollection of the feast turned battle.
